## Summary of changes

Two refactorings applied to `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math3/util/FastMath.java`:

1. **Extracted `expm1Large(double x)`** — pulled the `|x| >= 1` branch out of `expm1(double, double[])` into a self-contained helper. This branch was a complete computation that did not interact with `hiPrecOut`, so factoring it out shrinks the body of `expm1` by ~13 lines and makes the small-|x| path the visual focus of the function.

2. **Extracted `logNearOne(double x)`** — pulled the `(0.99, 1.01)` fast-path block out of `log(double, double[])`. This block is the `hiPrec == null` direct polynomial expansion in `x - 1` (using `LN_QUICK_COEF`). The caller now retains the range check and condition, and delegates the body to the new helper. This shrinks `log()` by ~20 lines and groups the helper next to the other log/polynomial helpers (`evaluateSplitPolynomial`).

Both extractions preserve numerical behavior bit-for-bit — the helpers contain the original code unchanged. Verified: `mvn compile` succeeds and `FastMathTest` (71 tests) plus the broader util suite (473 tests) all pass with no failures.
